design.principle: Separate Western diagnoses, Eastern disease names, TCM patterns, medications, acupuncture strategies, herbal strategies, and cautions. Connect overlap through relation records.
design.reason: One biomedical disease can connect to many TCM disease categories and patterns, and one TCM pattern can appear in many biomedical diseases.

western_conditions.summary_zh: 西醫診斷層，之後可連接月經不規則、不孕、胰島素阻抗、高雄激素表現與促排卵流程。
western_conditions.summary_en: Biomedical diagnosis layer. Later links may include irregular menstruation, infertility, insulin resistance, hyperandrogenism, and ovulation induction workflow.
western_conditions.red_flags_zh: 異常大量出血、懷孕可能、劇烈腹痛、快速體重變化或代謝異常需醫療評估。
western_conditions.red_flags_en: Heavy abnormal bleeding, possible pregnancy, severe pelvic pain, rapid weight change, or metabolic abnormalities require medical evaluation.

western_conditions.summary_zh: 用於連接排卵、精液、輸卵管、子宮腔等檢查未明顯異常但仍未孕的流程。
western_conditions.summary_en: Used for cases where ovulation, semen analysis, tubal patency, and uterine cavity evaluation do not reveal a clear cause.

western_medication_classes.herb_interaction_watch_en: Flag for review before combining with hormone-active herbs or fertility formulas.

fertility_workflow_template.biomedical_goal_en: Clarify ovulation, ovarian reserve, semen factors, tubal patency, uterine cavity, thyroid/prolactin/metabolic context as appropriate.
fertility_workflow_template.tcm_goal_zh: 辨病與辨證分開記錄，不急著套單一證型。
fertility_workflow_template.acupuncture_role_en: Support stress regulation, cycle tracking, pain/sleep support where appropriate.
fertility_workflow_template.herbal_role_en: Avoid formula selection until pregnancy status, medication plan, and red flags are clarified.

fertility_workflow_template.biomedical_goal_en: Coordinate with prescribed medication timing and monitoring plan.
fertility_workflow_template.tcm_goal_zh: 依週期與證型調整補腎、疏肝、化痰濕、活血等方向。
fertility_workflow_template.acupuncture_role_en: Track cycle day, symptoms, medication use, and avoid unsafe assumptions.
fertility_workflow_template.herbal_role_en: Flag herb-drug interaction review before combining formulas with fertility medications.

fertility_workflow_template.biomedical_goal_en: Align supportive care with retrieval, transfer, luteal support, and clinic restrictions.
fertility_workflow_template.tcm_goal_zh: 以安全、減壓、睡眠、消化與疼痛支持為主，避免干擾西醫療程。
fertility_workflow_template.acupuncture_role_en: Document timing relative to retrieval/transfer and clinic instructions.
fertility_workflow_template.herbal_role_en: Use extra caution; many clinics restrict herbs during stimulation, transfer, or early pregnancy.
